shapeSummary: NEMA 17 stepper motor body (42.3 x 38 x 42.3 mm, chamfered vertical corners) with the axis along Y. The body has four blind M3 corner holes on a 31 mm pitch and a 22 mm pilot boss on top. An 8 mm lead screw rises from the boss to a total height of 282 mm. A simple brass flange nut (22 mm flange, 12 mm hub) sits on the screw.
warnings: The 282 mm overall length is unverified. It could be the screw length alone, so the screw's exposed length is uncertain.
The 3 mm hole diameter, 31 mm spacing and 4.5 mm depth come from the NEMA 17 standard, not from the images.
The pilot boss diameter and height (22 x 2 mm) are standard-based estimates.
The 3 mm corner chamfer is an estimate.
The nut position along the screw is a guess; it should be adjusted to match the intended nut position.
The nut's four mounting holes are omitted because their size and position are not given.
The wires, label, screw threads and rear bearing details are not modeled.
cadquery:
body = cq.Workplane('XY').box(42.3, 38, 42.3, centered=(True, False, True)).edges('|Y').chamfer(3)
pts = [(15.5, 15.5), (-15.5, 15.5), (15.5, -15.5), (-15.5, -15.5)]
holes = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 33.5, 0)).pushPoints(pts).circle(1.5).extrude(-5)
body = body.cut(holes)
boss = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 38, 0)).circle(11).extrude(-2)
screw = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 40, 0)).circle(4).extrude(-242)
flange = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 80, 0)).circle(11).extrude(-4)
hub = cq.Workplane('XZ', origin=(0, 84, 0)).circle(6).extrude(-8)
part = body.union(boss).union(screw).union(flange).union(hub)
